---
title: "Claude AI +  Tidycensus"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
# Install if needed
# install.packages("tidycensus")


library(tidycensus)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Set your key once (saves to ~/.Renviron)
# census_api_key("PUT_API_KEY_HERE", install = TRUE)

# --- Example 1: Population by state ---
pop_by_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = "B01003_001",   # Total population
  year = 2023,
  survey = "acs1"
)

# --- Example 2: Median income + poverty rate by county ---
income_poverty <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  state = "CA",
  variables = c(
    median_income = "B19013_001",
    poverty_rate  = "B17001_002"
  ),
  year = 2023,
  survey = "acs5"
)

# --- Example 3: Pull with geometry for mapping ---

income_map <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2023,
  geometry = TRUE   # includes sf geometry for mapping
)

ggplot(income_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::dollar) +
  labs(title = "Median Household Income by County, Texas (2023)",
       fill = "Median Income") +
  theme_minimal()
```
